name.description: The person's full name. Required unless item is given.

company.description: Where they work now. Required unless item is given.

profile_url.description: A public profile or bio page the user says is this person.

item.description: In a fan-out agent: this branch's list-prepare slot {i, item_key, label, query}. null = empty slot.

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601, for report.meta and the recency rule (months_ago). Optional: on JoyStream the template binds it to the run start time. Never guessed.
